# Demonstration media credits

The screenshots and walkthrough show the VibeLeak Atlas plugin with sample website responses and a sample PHP project. No client project or production security finding appears in the demonstration.

- Product logos and artwork: VibeLeak, supplied by the project owner.
- Music: **Synth Wave** by Alex McCulloch / Pro Sensory. [Original recording](https://opengameart.org/content/synth-wave). [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
- Sound effects: generated with [Earshot](https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot), MIT-licensed tooling.
- Voiceover: synthetic narration. Speech captions are included in the video.

`vibeleak-atlas-demo.mp4` is the compact 720p copy of the full 93-second film. `walkthrough.gif` is a silent 15-second selection from that film. The logo files and native screenshots retain their original proportions.
